name: Valefar
source:
Age: XX | LV 8 Reaper

A man with a kind heart yet a very dry sense of sarcasm. Perhaps he can be considered the true father of the group, and is the only one to be able to handle the chaos.

He holds great distrust of humankin and chooses to remain a reaper rather than reincarnate.

Some find that strange, but it is a life that keeps him content. Chooses to appear older to act as an uncle towards young spirits.

LIKES
Reading, cars, quiet time, practicing combat, hard drinks, vacations (rare). Cooking videos with dogs.

DISLIKES
Noise. Having to finish Caym's paperwork for him. When the guys get too troublesome. Most humans.

[From [url=https://mobile.twitter.com/rosemilkstudio/status/1569470305651019776]Twitter[/url]]
